  • Viqar-ul-Mulk)

questions.question: Explain the constitutional basis for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the / Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies.
questions.solution_html:
• Reservation for SCs and STs is mandated under Articles 330 and 332—ensures political
  • representation—promotes social justice and equality in legislatures.
questions.final_answer: Reservation for SCs and STs is mandated under Articles 330 and 332—ensures political
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Suggest measures to ensure fair implementation of EWS reservation in / educational institutions.
questions.solution_html:
• Fair EWS reservation requires transparent income and asset criteria—systematic data
  • robust verification mechanisms—periodic review – mechanisms for preventing misuse and
  • ensure genuine beneficiaries.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the constitutional provisions related to secularism in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Secularism enshrined in Preamble -defines India as a secular nation- Articles 25-28—
  • guarantees freedom of religion—mandates equal treatment of all faiths by the state.
questions.final_answer: Secularism enshrined in Preamble -defines India as a secular nation- Articles 25-28
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss on Cooperative Federalism in the Indian context.
questions.solution_html:
• Cooperative federalism emphasizes collaboration between Union and States—NITI Aayog
  • nurtures shared policy-making—strengthens inclusive development and balanced governance.
questions.final_answer: Cooperative federalism emphasizes collaboration between Union and States—NITI Aayog
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the Subaltern perspective on Indian nationalism.
questions.solution_html:
• Subaltern perspective highlights marginalized voices—critiques elite-centric nationalism—
  • emphasizes grassroots struggles in shaping Indian identity.
questions.final_answer: Subaltern perspective highlights marginalized voices—critiques elite-centric nationalism
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the reasons advanced by members who supported retaining the name / “India.
questions.solution_html:
• Supporters of “India” stressed historical continuity—legal and constitutional orientation
  • global recognition of the name—unity and inclusiveness across diverse communities.
questions.final_answer: Supporters of “India” stressed historical continuity—legal and constitutional orientation
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the relationship between coalition politics and multi-party democracy.
questions.solution_html:
• Coalition politics arises from multi-party democracy—requires consensus-building—often
  • leads to compromise governance but reflects pluralism.
questions.final_answer: Coalition politics arises from multi-party democracy—requires consensus-building—often
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define religious nationalism in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Religious nationalism links faith with political identity—mobilizes communities around
  • cultural-religious symbols—shapes socio-political discourse in India.
questions.final_answer: Religious nationalism links faith with political identity—mobilizes communities around
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the importance of L.M. Singhvi Committee
questions.solution_html:
• L.M. Singhvi Committee- emphasized grassroots democracy—recommended
  • constitutional recognition of Panchayati Raj—strengthened decentralization and local
  • governance.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How does the territorial-geographical perspective define India as a nation? / Discuss its significance in the nationalist movement.
questions.solution_html:
• Territorial perspective defines India through geography and boundaries—reinforced unity
  • during nationalist movement—significance lay in collective identity across diverse regions.
questions.final_answer: Territorial perspective defines India through geography and boundaries—reinforced unity
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Critically examine the Revolt of 1857 as a turning point in the Indian national / . CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Revolt of 1857-exposed deep discontent against colonial rule—though suppressed, it
  • marked the first large-scale resistance—created a sense of unity across regions and classes
  • laying groundwork for later nationalist movements.
questions.final_answer: laying groundwork for later nationalist movements
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Assess the impact of regional parties on democratic representation in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Regional parties amplify local voices—strengthen representation of diverse communities—
  • shape coalition governments and policies, ensuring inclusivity but sometimes fragmenting
  • national consensus.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Indian secularism is a multi-value, contextual model that emphasizes principled / distance rather than strict, western style separation. Discuss.
questions.solution_html:
• Indian secularism emphasizes principled distance—state engages with religions
  • contextually—balances freedom of faith with social reform, unlike strict western separation
  • reflecting pluralism and diversity.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Illustrate about the Indian Federal structure during an Emergency.
questions.solution_html:
• During Emergency, federal structure tilted towards central dominance—state powers
  • curtailed—President and Union government exercised overriding authority-increasing role for
  • parliament- weakening autonomy but highlighting resilience of constitutional safeguards post
  • crisis.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
